source.anchor: Camera Calibration, pinhole intrinsics camera matrix
source.law: u=fx * Xc/Zc + cx, v=fy * Yc/Zc + cy, Zc != 0; inverse normalized ray x=(u-cx)/fx, y=(v-cy)/fy
source.exclusions: lens radial/tangential distortion, extrinsic pose, sensor physical pitch, zoom calibration and actual hardware measurements

interest_donors: astrophotography using a real camera/zoom lens
provenance.provenance_type: user research motivation only, not a claim of implemented author-owned camera calibration code

policy.interpretation: research candidates for language-visible mathematical laws, NOT source-implemented SENS semantics; require D1-D9 exact and behavioral dedup, Core-vs-library justification, independent oracle before selection

candidates.behavior: Return exact (u,v)=(fx*Xc/Zc+cx,fy*Yc/Zc+cy). Mathematically defined for negative Z too; a separate physical visibility predicate may require Z>0. Do not silently apply lens distortion or infer extrinsics.
falsifiers: Zc=0 is an explicit invalid projection, not infinity, a float, or a dropped point.
Scaling (Xc,Yc,Zc) by any nonzero rational must not change the pixel projection.
Optical distortion/pose and sensor pitch cannot be introduced implicitly.
candidates.dedup: Exact name absent among 634 D10 and D1-D9; this may be a projection of exact division/multiplication and matrix algebra. Status HOLD until behavioral dedup and Core root minimality.

candidates.behavior: Return canonical unnormalized direction ((u-cx)/fx,(v-cy)/fy,1) in camera coordinates. This is a RAY, not a reconstructed 3D point/depth. For a distortion-free pinhole, projecting any nonzero exact multiple of the direction returns the original pixel.
falsifiers: fx=0 or fy=0 must not be accepted.
Recovered ray may not falsely claim unique object distance.
Composing ray and projection must reproduce the input pixel exactly.
candidates.dedup: Exact name absent in selected D10 and D1-D9; projection from exact arithmetic and matrix inverse may make this a derived library function.

derived_and_hold.name: PINHOLE-RAY-PIXEL-COMPOSITION
derived_and_hold.reason: Forward project of canonical inverse ray is identity; theorem, not a third operation.

derived_and_hold.name: CAMERA-DEPTH-FROM-PIXEL
derived_and_hold.reason: One pinhole image coordinate cannot recover an absolute 3D depth without additional information.

derived_and_hold.name: REAL-LENS-DISTORTION-CALIBRATION
derived_and_hold.reason: Would require measured radial/tangential coefficients and device calibration, not inferred from user's camera model.

derived_and_hold.name: CAMERA-EXTRINSIC-POSE
derived_and_hold.reason: Full world-to-camera rigid transform is an independent data/model contract; outside this proposal.

required_oracles: Independent Python Fraction exact algebra test over at least 10^4 bounded points
OpenCV primary equation verified with scale-invariance countermodels
Native SENS exact rational implementation equality oracle prior to SELECTED
owner_decision: No ratification implied; mathematical equivalence to existing D6/D8/D9 arithmetic may keep both as normal self-hosted library projections.
